comment: EMA and FDA both specify 20 MG/G (2%). DailyMed links this same US product to RxCUI 2721172, whose normalized name uses 20 MG/ML and whose synonym is Anzupgo 2 % Topical Cream; this is terminology normalization, not a different product strength.
